summary: The corrected candidate now compiles through Client but the test assembly fails: WorktreeGit was made file-private while existing bounded-process tests still access it. The resolver also has an incomplete match for cold lookup errors (FS0025), risking MatchFailure instead of a fail-closed error.

Then add process-count, distinct-checkout, dirty/detached/HEAD, move/concurrent-move, unknown-selector and symlink regression tests.
